text:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH: gpu-queue-length on prod inference clusters exceeding 95th percentile threshold for 8m. Possible HPA metrics lag. Paging on-call.

erin: I’m on it, grabbing context. seeing alerts for autoscale stalls and high queue growth in regions-us-west1.

sam: I can help — oncall handoff in 10 if needed. any customer-facing impact yet?

erin: support-bot reported elevated 429s and timeouts for a handful of customers hitting high-throughput endpoints. not full outage but request queueing leading to throttles.

maria: Prometheus scrape backlog spiking, adapter pod logs show repeated 504s to prometheus + OOM restarts over last 6m. suspect metrics-adapter is slow/blocked.

erin: pulling prometheus-adapter logs now.

maria: logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z WARN adapter: scrape loop backlog=1200 target_count=450 latency=2.4s
2026-03-15T09:15:41Z ERROR adapter: downstream request failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T09:16:03Z ERROR adapter: handler panic: runtime: out of memory
```

erin: ugh, OOMs. looks like adapter is GCing or hitting memory pressure, leading to delayed custom metrics -> HPA not seeing actual queue length. HPA remains at low replicas while queue grows.

kyle: quick mitigation: we can manual-scale GPU pool to absorb backlog, then fix metrics. recommend bumping replicas by +40% and increasing HPA target temporarily.

anita: agree. also restart prometheus-adapter pods one at a time after adjusting memory limit to avoid thrashing.

erin: doing manual scale now: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-nodes --replicas=14` (was 10) — running.

devops-bot: Deploy request: scale deployment/gpu-nodes -> 14 accepted. rollout started. current availableReplicas=6 -> new target 14. estimated spin-up 4-6m.

sam: while nodes spin, I'll patch prometheus-adapter resource limits and restart pods. applying patch now: ```kubectl -n monitoring patch deployment prometheus-adapter -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"adapter","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"512Mi"}}}]}}}}'```

maria: patch applied. restarting pods sequentially to avoid metric gaps. `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter` (one-by-one due to topol policy).

erin: checking HPA status and custom metrics. `kubectl -n inference get hpa/gpu-workers -o wide` shows metrics missing: ```
NAME          REFERENCE                TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
gpu-workers   Deployment/gpu-workers   <unknown>/80%    2         20        2
```

anita: that <unknown> confirms adapter not serving metric. once adapter pods are healthy and metrics exported, HPA should react.

support-bot: Notifying impacted customers: sending status note to tier-2 and product. some customers seeing 2-10s extra lat and intermittent 429. no data loss.

erin: rollout of gpu nodes at 12% available. queue length plateaued but not yet decreasing. still seeing ~30% of requests queued > 500ms.

maria: prometheus-adapter pod 1 healthy, pod 2 restarting, memory usage trending down after patch. adapter now returning metrics for custom.metric.gpu_queue_length: ```{"value": 0.82, "timestamp": 2026-03-15T09:28:10Z}```

kyle: patch HPA to temporarily raise target to 60% and allow faster scaling: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa gpu-workers -p '{"spec":{"targetCPUUtilizationPercentage":60}}'`

erin: done. HPA now seeing metric and scaling events triggered. replicas ramping: 2 -> 6 -> 10 -> hitting new nodes as available.

devops-bot: Autoscale events: replicas increased to 10 at 2026-03-15T09:35:02Z, to 13 at 2026-03-15T09:42:18Z.

anita: after adapter stabilizes, we should revert HPA tweak and investigate root cause: why adapter OOMed — large scrape backlog + memory leak suspicion.

sam: agree. I'll open an incident ticket for memory profiling and scrape config audit. also scheduling a follow-up runbook update for sequential adapter restarts.

erin: customer update: latency and 429s mostly cleared after scale. support-bot will post status update to affected customers and mark as degraded but mitigated.

support-bot: Status update sent to customers flagged by the alert. message: "We observed elevated inference latency and throttling due to delayed autoscaling from a metrics pipeline degradation. We've scaled capacity and restarted monitoring adapters; service performance is back to nominal. Investigations ongoing."

maria: collecting adapter heap dumps and prometheus TSDB metrics for 09:00-09:30 window. uploading to /internal/incidents/2190123456/ for postmortem.

erin: handoff to @sam for follow-up. I'm pausing monitoring rotation. thanks all.

sam: taking post-incident. will coordinate RCA, memory profiling, and a follow-up runbook entry. ETA initial RCA 48h.

anita: action items: [1] increase prometheus-adapter memory limit to 1Gi (done), [2] add liveness probe backoff and heap-monitoring alert, [3] review scrape interval/targets to reduce backlog, [4] add HPA fallback policy to allow manual autoscale when metrics unknown.

erin: closing note: no customer data lost, all critical customers restored. creating postmortem checklist.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and marked mitigated at 2026-03-15T10:17:36Z. severity: Sev2 -> monitoring for recurrence.

sam: filing postmortem now, will include timeline, heap dumps, and mitigations. thanks team :thumbsup:
